elicit-requirements.description: Would turn stakeholder interviews and existing process evidence into structured needs, clarifying user problems, desired outcomes and unanswered questions.
inputs: Stakeholder list and interview notes
Current workflows and user feedback
Business problem brief and known constraints
outputs: Stakeholder needs register with source links

define-scope.description: Would establish the delivery boundary and measurable business goals, distinguishing included capabilities, exclusions and assumptions for stakeholder agreement.
inputs: Stakeholder needs and business case
Budget, schedule and policy constraints
Existing product capabilities and boundaries
outputs: Scope statement with inclusions and exclusions

analyze-requirements.description: Would detect ambiguity, duplication and conflicts in requirements, then propose priorities using business value, risk, dependencies and delivery constraints.
inputs: Draft requirements and agreed scope
Prioritization criteria and stakeholder value
Known risks, dependencies and constraints

define-acceptance-criteria.description: Would translate requirements into observable pass and fail conditions, including normal behavior, boundaries and error cases that product and test teams can review.
inputs: Prioritized requirements and user stories
Business rules and user scenarios
Quality targets and interface constraints

review-requirements.description: Would assemble a requirements review, check completeness and testability, and capture stakeholder comments and agreement evidence without granting approval itself.
inputs: Requirements, scope and acceptance criteria
Review checklist and stakeholder feedback
Decision owners and approval process

assess-feasibility.description: Would compare solution options against technical, operational, cost and schedule constraints, identifying uncertain assumptions that need experiments or specialist review.
inputs: Requirements and quality targets
Technology landscape and team capabilities
Cost, schedule and operational constraints
outputs: Risk register with mitigations and owners

design-solution-architecture.description: Would propose system boundaries, major components and deployment structure, explaining how the architecture meets requirements and where tradeoffs remain.
inputs: Reviewed requirements and feasibility findings
Quality attributes and platform constraints
Existing architecture and integration context

design-user-experience.description: Would draft user journeys, interaction flows and interface concepts that address user goals, accessibility needs and expected error or recovery states.
inputs: User profiles, research and key scenarios
Requirements and acceptance criteria
Design system and accessibility requirements
outputs: Usability review questions and UI state definitions

design-system-components.description: Would specify APIs, data structures and integration behavior in enough detail for implementation and testing, including validation, errors, compatibility and data ownership.
inputs: Solution architecture and functional requirements
External interface contracts and data rules
Security, privacy and performance constraints

review-solution-design.description: Would review the proposed design for requirement coverage, security, privacy, operability and testability, recording evidence and unresolved concerns for accountable reviewers.
inputs: Architecture, UI and component designs
Requirements and applicable security standards
Threat scenarios and design review checklist
outputs: Design review findings with severity and rationale
Design decision log and unresolved risks

decompose-work.description: Would split the agreed scope into deliverable backlog items and implementation tasks, keeping acceptance criteria, test work and design dependencies visible.
inputs: Prioritized requirements and acceptance criteria
Reviewed architecture and component designs
Team backlog conventions and delivery constraints
outputs: Epics, stories and actionable task breakdown
Dependencies and completion criteria per item

estimate-delivery.description: Would propose effort ranges and compare planned work with available team capacity, exposing assumptions and uncertainty for the team to validate.
inputs: Backlog items and task breakdown
Historical delivery data or expert estimates
Team availability, skills and working calendar
outputs: Effort estimates with ranges and rationale
Estimation assumptions and team review questions

map-dependencies.description: Would map technical, delivery and external dependencies, identify sequencing constraints and highlight unresolved commitments that could delay planned work.
inputs: Backlog and solution component relationships
External team commitments and supplier dates
Environment, approval and integration prerequisites
outputs: Dependency register with owners and needed dates

plan-iterations.description: Would organize prioritized work into feasible iterations and milestones using capacity, dependencies and release objectives, with explicit assumptions for team review.
inputs: Prioritized backlog and effort estimates
Capacity plan and dependency register
Milestone targets and delivery calendar
outputs: Proposed iteration plan and milestone schedule

plan-testing.description: Would define a risk-based testing approach, coverage goals, environments and entry and exit criteria, allowing test preparation to begin during requirements work.
inputs: Requirements, acceptance criteria and architecture
Product risks and delivery milestones
Test policies, resources and environment constraints
outputs: Test strategy and scoped test plan

create-test-cases.description: Would derive reviewable test cases from requirements and risks, including prerequisites, data, execution steps and expected results for positive, negative and boundary behavior.
inputs: Requirements and acceptance criteria
Test strategy, risks and design specifications
Test case template and domain rules
outputs: Preconditions, data needs and expected results

review-test-coverage.description: Would review test quality and traceability, identify missing or duplicate scenarios, and show whether requirements and priority risks have meaningful test coverage.
inputs: Test cases and requirement identifiers
Acceptance criteria and risk register
Coverage rules and review checklist
outputs: Coverage gap and duplicate case report
Test review findings and revision actions

prepare-test-resources.description: Would prepare or specify representative test data and a reproducible test environment, checking access, configuration and cleanup needs before execution.
inputs: Test cases and data requirements
Environment topology and access authorization
Configuration baselines and data handling rules
outputs: Environment setup scripts or configuration checklist
Resource readiness record and cleanup procedure

build-test-automation.description: Would turn selected test cases into maintainable automated checks, integrating fixtures, assertions and reporting with the agreed test framework and delivery pipeline.
inputs: Reviewed automation candidate test cases
Application interfaces and test framework
Test data, environments and pipeline conventions
outputs: Automated test code and reusable fixtures
Setup guide and automation validation results

implement-feature.description: Would implement a scoped feature and its unit tests from approved requirements and design, documenting assumptions and behavior that still needs review.
inputs: Assigned work item and acceptance criteria
Reviewed design and existing source code
Coding standards and development setup
outputs: Feature code and associated unit tests

validate-code.description: Would run unit tests and agreed static checks against a specific code revision, distinguishing code defects from tooling or environment failures.
inputs: Code revision and unit test suite
Lint, type-check and static analysis configuration
Build dependencies and validation thresholds
outputs: Unit test results and coverage report
Static analysis findings with affected locations

review-code.description: Would examine a proposed change for correctness, maintainability, security and test coverage, then help resolve review feedback with traceable revisions.
inputs: Code diff and linked requirement or defect
Test results and code review standards
Reviewer feedback and relevant design decisions
outputs: Feedback resolution log and remaining concerns

integrate-changes.description: Would help merge changes after recorded approvals and required checks, checking branch state and surfacing conflicts that require developer judgment.
inputs: Approved change request and source/target branches
Required check results for the change revision
Merge policy and repository write authorization
outputs: Merge or integration result with commit reference
Conflict resolutions or unresolved conflict report

build-application.description: Would build and package a defined code revision using the agreed toolchain, capturing artifact identity and build evidence for later deployment and traceability.
inputs: Integrated code revision and version identifier
Build scripts, dependency locks and toolchain
Packaging rules and target platform configuration
outputs: Versioned application package or container image

validate-ci-checks.description: Would assess the required continuous integration checks for a specific revision, identify missing or failed jobs and summarize whether pipeline requirements are satisfied.
inputs: Pipeline definition and required check policy
Pipeline run, code revision and artifact references
Test, analysis and security scan results
outputs: CI check status summary with evidence links
Missing, failed or skipped job analysis

deploy-test-build.description: Would deploy a traceable build to the test environment. During defect resolution, it would also coordinate the corrected-code rebuild and redeployment, preserving version and configuration evidence.
inputs: Validated build artifact or corrected source revision
Build/deploy pipeline and environment configuration
Test deployment authorization and rollback procedure
outputs: Rebuild evidence when needed and deployed build ID
Deployment log and environment version record

execute-smoke-tests.description: Would check critical service paths after test or production deployment. Production checks would use the approved scope, data and permissions appropriate to the live service.
inputs: Environment-specific smoke test suite
Deployed version, endpoints and configuration
Approved test accounts, data and execution scope
outputs: Smoke test results with build and environment IDs

execute-integration-tests.description: Would execute tests across component and external-system boundaries, checking contracts, data exchange, error handling and interactions in the integrated environment.
inputs: Integration test suite and interface contracts
Integrated build and dependent service configuration
Test datasets, stubs and service access
outputs: Integration test results with environment details
Defect candidates linked to failing interactions

execute-functional-tests.description: Would execute system and functional scenarios against acceptance criteria, recording actual behavior and evidence for user workflows, business rules and error paths.
inputs: Reviewed system and functional test cases
Deployed test build and acceptance criteria
Test data, user roles and execution access
outputs: Test execution records with actual results

execute-nonfunctional-tests.description: Would execute the relevant performance, security, reliability, accessibility or other quality checks, comparing measured behavior with agreed targets and documenting test limitations.
inputs: Risk-based non-functional test scope and targets
Representative environment, workloads and tools
Authorized execution window and monitoring setup
outputs: Measurements and comparison with quality targets
Quality risks, findings and tuning recommendations

execute-regression-tests.description: Would run the agreed regression suite during test execution and select affected regression checks after defect fixes, recording the selection rationale and any residual coverage risk.
inputs: Regression suite and requirement coverage map
Change or defect impact analysis
Target build, environment and test data
outputs: Selected regression scope and selection rationale
Regression results with evidence and build ID
New failures, excluded coverage and residual risks

report-test-progress.description: Would consolidate execution and defect evidence into an accurate progress view, separating passed, failed, blocked and unexecuted tests and highlighting risks to the test plan.
inputs: Execution records and evidence links
Defect register and planned test scope
Coverage baseline and reporting period
outputs: Test progress report with defined status counts
Forecast risks and recommended next actions

assess-test-readiness.description: Would compare current test evidence with agreed exit criteria and present gaps and residual risks so a human test owner can decide whether testing may exit.
inputs: Agreed test exit criteria
Latest execution, coverage and defect evidence
Known risks and documented exception requests
outputs: Unmet criteria and residual risk summary
Recommendation and evidence for the human gate

triage-defects.description: Would turn failure evidence into reproducible defect reports, identify likely duplicates and propose severity, priority and ownership for the triage team to confirm.
inputs: Failure evidence and reproduction steps
Build, environment and impacted requirement
Defect taxonomy and existing defect register
outputs: Triage notes, owner suggestions and next actions

fix-defects.description: Would investigate a reproduced defect, implement a focused correction and regression protection, and prepare the change for review with evidence that the root cause is addressed.
inputs: Triaged defect and reproduction evidence
Affected code, logs and system design
Expected behavior and code review standards
outputs: Proposed fix and root cause explanation
Unit or regression tests for the defect
Validation evidence and change review package

retest-defects.description: Would repeat defect reproduction steps on the corrected build, compare results with expected behavior and recommend closure or reopening with explicit evidence.
inputs: Defect report and original failure evidence
Corrected build and fix deployment record
Retest steps, expected results and test data
outputs: Fix verification linked to defect and build

support-uat.description: Would prepare and coordinate user acceptance testing with business representatives, capture their observations and support an acceptance decision grounded in agreed business scenarios.
inputs: Business scenarios and acceptance criteria
UAT build, user accounts and representative data
Business participants, schedule and acceptance process
outputs: UAT scenario pack and participant guidance
User results, feedback and issue log
Acceptance evidence and pending business decisions

summarize-test-results.description: Would produce a test summary for the release candidate, reconciling planned scope, executed coverage, defects, deviations and residual risks into a reviewable evidence record.
inputs: Test plan and release candidate identifier
Execution, coverage, defect and UAT records
Exit assessment and accepted test deviations
outputs: Evidence index and residual quality risks

assess-release-readiness.description: Would evaluate the release candidate against agreed quality, security and operational criteria, identifying blockers and evidence gaps for accountable release reviewers.
inputs: Release readiness criteria and candidate identity
Test summary, UAT and security review evidence
Operational readiness, support and dependency checks

plan-release.description: Would draft an executable deployment and rollback plan with prerequisites, responsibilities, validation steps and recovery triggers appropriate to the release and production environment.
inputs: Release scope, artifacts and target environment
Deployment dependencies and readiness findings
Change window, owners and recovery requirements
outputs: Deployment runbook with sequence and checkpoints
Rollback plan, triggers and recovery validation

prepare-release-decision.description: Would assemble a concise approval package with readiness evidence, deployment risks and open exceptions. It would support the human release approver and record their decision only when supplied.
inputs: Release readiness assessment and test summary
Deployment/rollback plan and exception requests
Approval criteria, named approvers and decision process
outputs: Release decision brief with linked evidence
Approval record template with pending questions
Human decision and conditions record, when provided

deploy-release.description: Would carry out the approved production deployment plan within its authorized scope, capturing checkpoints and invoking approved recovery steps when specified conditions are met.
inputs: Recorded human release approval and conditions
Versioned release artifacts and approved runbook
Production authorization, configuration and rollback assets
outputs: Production deployment record and active version
Completion, failure or rollback outcome report

monitor-and-support.description: Would analyze operational telemetry and support cases, identify incidents or degrading service behavior, and propose or execute authorized runbook steps with traceable outcomes.
inputs: Production metrics, logs, alerts and service targets
Support tickets and current deployment context
Runbooks, escalation rules and action authorization
outputs: Support responses or runbook action records

analyze-product-feedback.description: Would combine user feedback, support themes and product usage evidence into validated problem statements and improvement proposals for the next requirements iteration.
inputs: User feedback, support cases and research notes
Usage metrics and business success measures
Current backlog and product strategy
outputs: Feedback themes linked to supporting evidence
Draft next-iteration requirements and open questions

resolve-release-blockers.description: Would translate a rejected or conditional release decision into owned remediation work, track corrective evidence and prepare the release for reassessment by its human reviewers.
inputs: Human release decision and stated blockers
Readiness findings, defects and exception conditions
Responsible owners and remediation constraints
outputs: Blocker remediation plan with owners and due dates
